title: chore(client): add a timeout argument to fetch
body:
## Summary
Add a timeout parameter to fetch() in src/client.py, pass it to _get(), and pass 30 from the call in src/jobs.py.

## Rationale
Callers need to choose a timeout for slow endpoints instead of always waiting 30 seconds.

## Testing
Validation plan: call run('u') in src/jobs.py and check that it returns ('u', 30).

## Limitations
Only fetch() and its call in src/jobs.py are changed; the timeout value is not validated.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/client.py b/src/client.py
--- a/src/client.py
+++ b/src/client.py
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@
     return (url, timeout)
 
 
-def fetch(url):
-    return _get(url, 30)
+def fetch(url, timeout):
+    return _get(url, timeout)

diff --git a/src/jobs.py b/src/jobs.py
--- a/src/jobs.py
+++ b/src/jobs.py
@@ -2,4 +2,4 @@
 
 
 def run(url):
-    return fetch(url)
+    return fetch(url, 30)
